game_concept: A tower defense set in Shadow Cave – Bat Hollow, a hollow of roosting bats: the torchbearer must hold off cave spiders while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Stamina Climb: Keep climbing while stamina > 0, deciding when to rest inside the loop.
theme: Shadow Cave – Bat Hollow: a hollow of roosting bats
core_gameplay_loop: In Bat Hollow, repeat each round: Keep climbing while stamina > 0, deciding when to rest inside the loop. Then check stamina and advance.
player_objective: Protect the crystal door from cave spiders in Bat Hollow: keep stamina above zero until the 50-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 3 (intro tier): Stamina Climb
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 4, Level 3, Need Assistance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
